name: What should I consider before contacting AKN Design Group about a custom patio project?

mainEntity.name: What should I consider before contacting AKN Design Group about a custom patio project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before contacting AKN Design Group for a custom patio project, homeowners should consider their primary goals for the space, such as entertaining, relaxation, or dining, and how they envision using it. Thinking about desired features like shade structures, fire pits, or specific landscaping elements can also be beneficial. While detailed plans are not required, having a general understanding of your aesthetic preferences and budget expectations will help us initiate a more focused conversation. Our team can then guide you through the specifics during our initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before contacting us, consider your primary goals for the patio, desired features, and general aesthetic preferences to help guide our initial consultation.
